learnings.title: Avoid bare word nothing in library descriptions
learnings.trigger: test_setup_library_talk negative test zzzz-nothing split into zzzz and nothing
learnings.anti_pattern: Using bare word nothing in skill description
learnings.solution: Use domain-specific phrases like no immunity or zero guarantee

learnings.title: Gate Fix: mockup/index.html
learnings.trigger: Breaker pentester blocked gate with PoC: Hash fragment #alert(1) unescaped in innerHTML
learnings.solution: Replaced innerHTML with textContent and validated encodeURIComponent sanitization.

learnings.title: Use safe_rmtree for temp git clones on Windows
learnings.trigger: update_plugin.py failed updating opencode and codex on Windows because git clone left read-only pack files
learnings.anti_pattern: Calling shutil.rmtree(..., ignore_errors=True) on directories that contain .git objects
learnings.solution: Use safe_rmtree which clears read-only flags before unlinking on Windows

learnings.title: Concurrent plugin updates break each other
learnings.trigger: auto update at session start while the user runs tw.py update
learnings.anti_pattern: two update_plugin runs share ~/.team-workflow/*-update and the Claude marketplace clone
learnings.solution: update_plugin.hold_lock: one run at a time, the second waits then rereads versions
